newsitem.title: USA: Speaker Gingrich planning trip to Asia this month.
newsitem.headline: Speaker Gingrich planning trip to Asia this month.

text.p: U.S. House of Representatives Speaker Newt Gingirch is planning a trip to Asia during the congressional Easter recess at the end of March, his office said on Friday.
Details, including the countries to be visited and the names of other members of Congress who will be going with Gingrich will be announced next week, a spokeswoman said.
The Wall Street Journal reported in its Friday editions that China would be one of the stops. The State Department would not confirm the report.
Gingrich, a Georgia Republican, has been keeping a low profile since he was reprimanded by the House in January and ordered to pay $300,000 for ethics violations.
